content: Yes, it is generally true that the annual siren test in Switzerland takes place on the first Wednesday in March. This test is conducted as part of Switzerland's civil defense system to ensure that the public warning siren network is functioning properly. The siren test typically occurs at noon on that day. However, it's always a good idea to check with official sources close to the date to confirm, as schedules can occasionally change or be adjusted due to holidays or other considerations.
